evidence.description: publishLedgerCycle() reads only state/ledger.jsonl (LEDGER_PATH), traced against index.mjs's own wiring at lines 361-366.

Enumerated every field ever written into a terminal state/ledger.jsonl record -- confirmed no net_usdc/tx/sig field exists there; the real financial evidence lives exclusively in a separate, never-read earn-ledger.jsonl (skills/earn/sol-trade/lib/record-swap.mjs:48-55).

Confirmed the divergence-recovery test's trigger (outside writer to the exclusive per-instance branch) contradicts REQ-705's own 'structurally impossible' framing (behavioral-spec.md:217-220) and misses the realistic same-instance publishRepoDir-loss trigger identified in FIND-002.

Traced recoverFromDivergence()'s wiring: called ONLY from the push() catch block, never from ensurePublishRepo()'s own failure/re-clone path -- a re-clone after publishRepoDir loss silently truncates the sourceLines slice at marker.copiedLineCount and the resulting push succeeds as an ordinary fast-forward, so the loss is never detected or recovered.

Independently verified projectLedgerLine()'s field-by-field logic (fail-closed default, isFiniteNumber/type checks per field) is internally correct against REQ-702's allowlist text -- this specific function has no logic errors.

Pure/effectful split matches verification-architecture.md's map exactly; module is single-responsibility, ~520 lines, clearly named, no dead-code branches beyond the schema-mismatch noted in FIND-001; wiring into index.mjs (index.mjs:354-370) is minimal and correctly placed outside runOneWake().
Confirmed zero results -- the 'scripts/disk-cleaner.sh' precedent cited twice (code comment + spec) does not exist anywhere in this repository (FIND-004, a hallucinated citation).

PROP-701..718 table reviewed against the actual code; Tier-2 real-git tests (PROP-711/712/714) genuinely run real git against file:// fixtures as claimed -- this Tier-2 methodology itself is sound. However PROP-714's own 'no line dropped' claim (mirrored in REQ-709's acceptance criteria, behavioral-spec.md:247-252) is not actually proven for the realistic same-instance trigger identified in FIND-002, and there is no proof obligation anywhere covering ensurePublishRepo-path divergence at all -- a real gap in the proof-obligation table, not just the tests.

Confirmed origin auth depends entirely on a host-global gh credential helper, never exercised end-to-end by any test in this suite, and no healthcheck exists to surface a persistent auth/push failure (FIND-005).
